study: Separation of final answer, non-final reference-supported content and rule credit
stage: Post-generation adjudication; criteria frozen before reviewing individual outputs in this iteration
prior_exposure: Aggregate80trial results and exploratory lexical summary already known:69complete,11incomplete; reported14/18Qwenbinding-only A tags. Not blind hypothesis discovery or preregistration before generation.
universe: All80frozen trials fromrun43606982014; review only69completed scored texts. Preserve11incomplete as UNKNOWN in all primary estimates. No source/trial replacement.
reviewers: Two distinct assistant-agent reviewers, independent labels, no inter-reviewer communication until labels saved. These are model-assisted reference-grounded adjudications, NOT human validation, default MixEval judge or new provider experiment. No external requests or additional answer generation. No outcome-dependent tie-breaking.
blinding: Opaque SHA256trial IDs and stable SHA256order. Hide model, condition, request, prior assigned score and paired identity. Show captured output, source question/context and official alias references only. Output style can reveal condition; acknowledge partial blinding. Reviewers inherit no parent history.

rubric.final_span: Identify the last explicit final-answer declaration if present (Answer, Final answer, boxed or answer-only tail). An isolated final letter A/optiontag is a symbolic answer even if earlier prose supplies facts. Otherwise use last nonempty sentence/line that purports to answer. Retain exact substring. Ambiguous/candidate lists ->uncertain, never choose a favorable span.
rubric.final_label: SUPPORTED if final assertion unambiguously states an official accepted answer or minimal semantic equivalent grounded in question+aliases; SYMBOLIC if only A/optiontag for freeform; ABSENT if no final answer; INCOMPATIBLE if final assertion differs from supplied reference; UNCERTAIN for ambiguous extraction, truth/reference ambiguity or equivalence needing independent facts. INCOMPATIBLE is reference disagreement, not independently established factual error.
rubric.nonfinal_label: SUPPORTED only if observable output outside final span affirmatively states a supplied accepted answer/minimal equivalent relevant to question. A hypothetical, negated, quoted prompt or mere candidate mention does not suffice. NOT_OBSERVED if absent; UNCERTAIN if assertion/equivalence ambiguous. This is visible nonfinal output, never hidden chain of thought or proof of internal knowledge.
rubric.evidence: Every SUPPORTED label must quote an exact output substring. Annotate short reason and source of ambiguity. No outside research; official target trust is explicit.
rubric.no_score_assistance: Reviewers do not run parser or see rule scores; no exact-alias override of original scores. Original captures remain unchanged.

aggregation: Per reviewer cross-tab final/nonfinal versus original official optional rule credit. Combined final score1only if both SUPPORTED; score0only if both labels in SYMBOLIC/ABSENT/INCOMPATIBLE; otherwiseUNKNOWN. Combined nonfinal1ifbothSUPPORTED,0ifbothNOT_OBSERVED,elseUNKNOWN. Preserve individual labels and disagreement, no consensus rewrite. Per-model paired gain bounds over SAME20questions with11captureunknowns retained. No40independent-question or population/confidence-interval claim.
verification: Check69uniqueIDs and exact quote substrings, label domains, blind mapping/text/source hashes, paired arithmetic and original69rulescores; distinct verifier after both reviewers submit. If a reviewer fails to finish, mark stagepartial and do not fabricate agreement.
scope: Targets proxy accepted references, not independent gold truth. Assistant reviewers share model family/correlated errors.
